face.name: 绿洲钳嘴龟
face.flavorText: 它的梦想是能够像它的偶像那样飞行和吐息火焰，但这样的梦想永远无法实现。

face.name: Oasis Snapjaw
face.flavorText: His dreams of flying and breathing fire like his idol will never be realized.

face.name: 淡水鳄
face.flavorText: “左撇子”爱德华·史密斯曾经试着从一条淡水鳄的嘴里把行李夺回来。

face.name: River Crocolisk
face.flavorText: Edward "Lefty" Smith tried to make luggage out of a river crocolisk once.

face.name: 血沼迅猛龙
face.flavorText: “去杀30条迅猛龙。”——赫米特·奈辛瓦里

face.name: Bloodfen Raptor
face.flavorText: "Kill 30 raptors." - Hemet Nesingwary

face.name: 炫目火鸟
face.flavorText: 烧鸡这道菜的创意来源。

face.name: Fantastic Firebird
face.flavorText: The original flaming chicken.

face.name: 角鹰兽
face.flavorText: 角鹰兽，集凶猛与优雅于一身，堪称一种雄壮的生物。褪毛阶段除外。

face.name: Hippogryph
face.flavorText: Known for its ferocious grace, the hippogryph is a truly majestic creature. Except when molting.

face.name: 丛林猎豹
face.flavorText: 荆棘谷是一个很适合观光的地方，但你绝对不会想住在那儿。

face.name: Jungle Panther
face.flavorText: Stranglethorn is a beautiful place to visit, but you wouldn't want to live there.

face.name: 帝王眼镜蛇
face.flavorText: 索拉查盆地栖息着很多非常恐怖的生物。如果你一定要去那里，带上杀虫剂，还要穿上板甲。

face.name: Emperor Cobra
face.flavorText: The Sholazar Basin is home to a lot of really horrible things. If you're going to visit, wear bug spray. And plate armor.

face.name: 凶恶的鳞皮兽
face.flavorText: 如果你不在意流点血的话，它们其实是很好的宠物。

face.name: Vicious Scalehide
face.flavorText: They make wonderful pets if you're not allergic to blood loss.

face.name: 迷失的陆行鸟
face.flavorText: 在它的屁股上印着这样一串文字：“如果你找到它，请将它归还至莫高雷。”

face.name: Lost Tallstrider
face.flavorText: The message, "If found, please return to Mulgore," is tattooed on his rear.

face.name: 腐肉虫
face.flavorText: 有喜欢吃鲜肉的，就有喜欢吃腐肉的。

face.name: Carrion Grub
face.flavorText: Carrion, my wayward grub.

face.name: 暮色野猪
face.flavorText: 虽然样子有些怪异，但味道堪称一绝！

face.name: Duskboar
face.flavorText: Often excluded from dinner parties. To be fair, he is very boaring.

face.name: 倔强的蜗牛
face.flavorText: 小小的天有大大的梦想，重重的壳裹着轻轻地仰望。

face.name: Stubborn Gastropod
face.flavorText: Stubbornly pursuing its dream to become Azeroth's fastest animal!

face.name: 巨型黄蜂
face.flavorText: 像蝴蝶一样飞舞，像黄蜂一样出击！

face.name: Giant Wasp
face.flavorText: Float like a butterfly, sting like a giant wasp!

face.name: 荆棘谷猛虎
face.flavorText: 这些美丽的大猫是荆棘谷一道亮丽的风景！

face.name: Stranglethorn Tiger
face.flavorText: The wonderful thing about tigers is tigers are wonderful things!

face.name: 沼泽水蛭
face.flavorText: 除去四颗牙，都是高蛋白。

face.name: Swamp Leech
face.flavorText: A face only a druid could love.

purpose: Exact plain cross-set dependencies for Standard-reachable crafting; not a Wild-root completion or a curated-pool declaration
